data.title: Saudi Water Authority Launches Campaign Urging Public to Report Water Violations
data.content:
Riyadh, November 20, 2026, SPA -- The Saudi Water Authority has launched an interactive awareness campaign, "Since You Saw It," to promote its mobile app, particularly its feature for reporting water-related violations, and to encourage the public to help protect water resources.
    The campaign highlights the role individuals can play in spotting and curbing water violations. By making digital reporting easier and guiding users through the app, it aims to speed up responses to violations, raise awareness of the app, and turn reporting from an occasional reaction into a responsible social habit, showing the impact of community involvement supported by strong digital infrastructure.
    Through the app, users can report leaks in water networks or on streets, sewage overflows or blockages, and problems at water-filling stations, as well as issues with non-network services such as water tankers and sewage trucks. This helps detect violations quickly, protecting customers and improving services.
    The campaign reflects the authority's use of awareness communication and digital solutions to foster a shared responsibility for protecting water and preserving it for future generations.
    -- SPA
